requirements.statement: For each input error, the expected data types and formats are suggested, where necessary.

citations.quote: Pour chaque erreur de saisie, les types et les formats de données sont-ils suggérés, si nécessaire ?
Pour chaque message d’erreur, vérifier que les types et les formats de données attendus sont suggérés ;

routes.statement: The error message suggests the expected data types and formats.

citations.quote: vérifier que les types et les formats de données attendus sont suggérés

routes.statement: The browser's own validation message, customised through the Constraint Validation API, or the help message of a pattern attribute given by the title attribute, provides the suggestion.

citations.quote: Ces messages sont personnalisables via l’API Constraint Validation, ce qui permet de personnaliser les messages d’erreur et de valider le critère.

L’attribut `pattern` permet d’effectuer automatiquement des contrôles de format (via des expressions régulières) et affiche un message d’aide personnalisable via l’attribut `title` : ce dispositif valide également le critère.

exceptions.statement: Suggestions are required only where necessary.

citations.quote: accompagné, si nécessaire, de suggestions facilitant la correction des erreurs de saisie

rationale.text: The test applies to input errors, which appear only after the user enters something and tries to validate, so it needs a state other than the page as loaded. Whether a suggestion is necessary, and whether a message suggests the expected types and formats, are judgment: they depend on what the field expects and on the meaning of the message. The technical note accepts browser validation messages customised through the Constraint Validation API, and a pattern attribute with a help message in title. A pattern with a title is visible in the markup, but whether the title suggests the format is again a reading, and a page can also meet the test with its own messages. No check can decide either way, so the entry is none with no link. No axe-core rule is tagged for this test. Applicability is judgment, since whether an error needs a suggestion is. Needs is state.

citations.quote: Retrouver dans le document les messages d’erreur ;
Certains types de contrôles en HTML5 proposent des messages d’aide à la saisie automatique
